rows.range: 1-3 (act1 The Landing, act2 The Monolith, act3 The Canvas); never goes back
rows.onLoad: Restored from the save. If the save has none, recomputed: act 2 once any seat has reached tune.act1-end-vp or the round is past tune.act1-end-round, act 3 likewise with tune.act2-end-vp and tune.act2-end-round. Never moved backwards.
rows._notes: The act changes at hook.turn-end, after that turn's themed-win checks (hook.evening-end), at most once per turn, matching acts.json.

rows.range: 1 or more
rows.onLoad: Restored from the save; if Root exposes its own counter (read.round > 0), that value wins.

rows.range: seats whose countdown banner is up (announced at the end of their turn, waiting for their next Birdsong)
rows.onLoad: For each seat in the set, rerun that character's confirm test on the loaded board; keep it (and redraw its banner) only if it passes, otherwise drop it and clear the banner.

rows.range: Safe or Finished
rows.initial: Safe until the first-launch question is answered; copied from opt.spoiler-mode when a game is created
rows.onLoad: Restored from the save: a game keeps the spoiler mode it started with, and a change to opt.spoiler-mode applies from the next game. Finished-mode 'mother' lines still wait for Act III.
rows._notes: The first-launch answer lives in the player's mod profile (opt.spoiler-mode); this row is the copy a game reads, taken once at game start as the settings system says.

rows.range: Easy, Normal or Hard
rows.initial: Normal (copied from opt.difficulty when the game is created)
rows.onLoad: Restored from the save, so a game keeps the difficulty it started with.

rows.range: every seat maps to one character id from characters.json
rows.initial: empty; filled as seats are assigned
rows.onLoad: Restored from the save, then each seat's engine (read.seat-engine) is compared with its character's engine; on a mismatch that seat plays plain Root (no themed win or bot plan) and the player is warned.

rows.range: each map role id to its clearings (one for most roles; none for Sirène or The Reacher when the Monolith lacks that many path neighbours; all river clearings for the Sacred River)
rows.initial: empty; filled at map load, or when Gustave's keep is placed if he is seated
rows.onLoad: Restored from the save as is, because roles never move during a game (Lumière stays the keep's corner even after the keep is gone). Only a save with no mod state recomputes them by the map_roles rules.

rows.range: true for a game created from the mod's character select; false for a plain Root game
rows.onLoad: True only if the save carries mod state for this game's ID; a save without it loads as plain Root.

rows.range: 0 = Free Play, 1-3 = game number in the 3-game campaign (Act I, Act II, Act III)
rows.onLoad: Kept in the player's profile, not the game save; a loaded campaign game keeps the number saved with it.

rows.range: true when the human lost the previous campaign game and gets the last expedition's journal (+1 card at setup)
rows.onLoad: Kept in the player's profile; spent at hook.setup-complete of the next campaign game.
rows._notes: The roster says the journal is 'worth +1 card'; read, as opt.campaign does, as one extra card in the human's opening hand.

rows.range: clearings ever flagged; Lumière always included; only grows
rows.onLoad: Restored from the save; ids not on the current map are dropped and Lumière is added back if missing. Flags never come off, so the board is not used to remove any.

rows.range: 0 to tune.gustave-arm-max (3)
rows.onLoad: Restored and clamped to 0..tune.gustave-arm-max.

rows.range: true while the Overcharge toggle is armed for his next battle
rows.onLoad: Always false after loading (a save never falls inside a battle); the arm keeps its charge.

rows.range: the bot's planned Route from Lumière to a Beachhead, in path order; empty for a human Gustave
rows.onLoad: Not trusted after loading: recomputed at his next Birdsong.

rows.range: 4 entries in order Florrie, Dorrie, Soarrie, Urrie. RockState fields: string Status (notSpawned | hidden | guarded | loose | heldByRuler | withVerso | held); ClearingId? Clearing (null while withVerso, heldByRuler or held); SeatId? HostSeat (the Nevron host for guarded rocks, Verso's seat for withVerso, null otherwise); int GuardsLeft (0-3). Soarrie's holder is HostSeat while withVerso, and the Monolith's current ruler while heldByRuler.
rows.onLoad: Restored from the save. Held rocks stay held. For each guarded rock, GuardsLeft = min(saved GuardsLeft, host warriors now in its clearing), and it becomes loose at 0. Guard floors and placement blocks are re-sent to the plugin (do.set-guard-floor, do.block-placement). Rocks whose act has not come yet stay notSpawned.
rows._notes: The roster's status list is hidden | guarded | loose | heldByRuler | held; notSpawned (a rock before its act) and withVerso (Soarrie on Verso's card) were added because the roster describes both states without naming them.

rows.range: true while the François decoy badge sits at Esquie's Nest
rows.initial: false; true at setup when Esquie is seated
rows.onLoad: Restored; forced false if the loaded act is 2 or later.

rows.range: index (0-3) of the rock the bot is chasing this turn, or null
rows.onLoad: Not trusted after loading: recomputed at his next Birdsong (a new target triggers his target bark).

rows.range: true once Still Life has moved a warrior this turn (v1.1)
rows.onLoad: Restored; reset at the next hook.turn-end.

rows.range: clearings where a Portrait was destroyed, mapped to her turns left to avoid rebuilding there (0-2)
rows.onLoad: Restored; entries for clearings not on the map are dropped.

rows.range: true while she holds a Sun charge (v1.1 Twilight)
rows.onLoad: Restored from the save (the charge is an event record the board cannot show).

rows.range: true while she holds a Moon charge (v1.1 Twilight)
rows.onLoad: Restored from the save.

rows.range: true from the start of her Evening (holding Sun and Moon) until her first battle of that Evening
rows.onLoad: Restored; cleared at the next hook.turn-end.
Restored and clamped to 0..tune.verso-rank-s.

rows.range: 'none', 'offensive', 'defensive' or 'virtuose' (cosmetic stance chip)
rows.onLoad: Restored from the save; cosmetic only.

rows.range: what she did during her current turn: 'battled', 'aided'
rows.onLoad: Restored; cleared at the next hook.turn-end.

rows.range: the bot's two chosen family factions (one in a 2-player game); empty for a human Maelle
rows.onLoad: Restored; seats that are now Hostile are dropped and re-picked at her next Birdsong.

rows.range: relic id of the Parents' Journal, or null before Act II
rows.onLoad: Restored; if that relic id no longer exists, the relic is re-found by its type, value and last place; if it cannot be found and it is not among her recovered relics, the tagging rule runs again.

rows.range: Stains held by element: 'fire' (Chroma Sample), 'ice' (Journal), 'lightning' (Route Chart); 0 or more each
rows.onLoad: Restored from the save.

rows.range: the element armed for her next battle, or null
rows.onLoad: Restored; dropped if she no longer holds a Stain of that element.

rows.range: 5 entries in order Agile, Caster, Balanced, Heavy, Almighty. FootState fields: bool Earned; SeatId? Faction (the seat it came from); int Order (1 for the first foot earned and rising; 0 while not earned).
rows.onLoad: Restored from the save; Almighty is cleared if the loaded act is below tune.monoco-almighty-act; feet whose Faction is no longer a seat are cleared.

rows.range: 'none' (Curator not seated), 'inert' (setup to end of Act II), 'tunnel' (opened at Act III), 'dig-owed' (fallback: his first Act III action is a free Dig into the Monolith), 'gone' (the Monolith tunnel was removed; he may Dig again normally)
rows.initial: none; inert at setup when the Curator is seated
rows.onLoad: Restored, then checked against the board: 'tunnel' with no Duchy tunnel in the Monolith becomes 'gone'; 'inert' in Act III becomes 'dig-owed' if the opening never happened.

rows.range: true once Visages and Sirène were both ruled at the end of a turn by seats other than the White-Haired Man and the Paintress (v1.1 Monolith Barrier)
rows.onLoad: Restored from the save; it never goes back up.
